panelId.title: Vivint system (panel ID)
panelId.description: Only needed if your Vivint account has more than one system. On startup the log lists every system as 'Found Vivint system [PanelId]:... [Name]:...'. Leave empty to use the first one.

apiLoginRefreshSecs.title: API Refresh
apiLoginRefreshSecs.description: How often should Vivint Homebridge renew the session token.

ignoreDeviceTypes.title: Ignore Devices
ignoreDeviceTypes.description: Selected device types / equipment codes / IDs would be ignored on startup. Useful in case of external integrations like Nest or MyQ that may be managed directly by another Homebridge plugin.

logDeviceList.title: Show device list
logDeviceList.description: Shows data for all configured Vivint devices in the log

disableCameras.title: Disable cameras
disableCameras.description: If checked, camera video feeds would not appear in Homebridge.

useExternalVideoStreams.title: Use external video streams
useExternalVideoStreams.description: Stream camera feeds from Vivint servers instead of streaming directly from the Panel.

doorbellCameraIds.title: Doorbell cameras
doorbellCameraIds.description: Cameras whose name contains 'doorbell' are set up as doorbells automatically. Add the name or ID of any other doorbell camera here (the log lists every camera with its ID on startup) to get ring notifications.

cameraMotionFromDeter.title: Camera motion from Smart Deter messages
cameraMotionFromDeter.description: Some cameras never report a person in view and send a Smart Deter message instead. Turn this on if a camera never shows motion in HomeKit; the log suggests it when such a message arrives. Unconfirmed: these messages might also be sent when Smart Deter switches on by schedule, which would show as motion.

cameraMotionFromStatus.title: Camera motion from camera status messages
cameraMotionFromStatus.description: Some cameras report motion as a short status message. Turn this on if a camera never shows motion in HomeKit; the log suggests it when such a message arrives. These messages are also sent when a detection ends, so you may get extra motion notifications.

videoProcessing.title: Camera live view video
videoProcessing.description: 'Pass through' sends the camera's video to HomeKit unchanged (the 1.10 behaviour; light on CPU). 'Transcode' re-encodes it at the size HomeKit asks for (1.11 - 1.12 behaviour; CPU-heavy, may be needed for viewing away from home / over cellular).

rtspTransport.title: Camera stream transport
rtspTransport.description: How the plugin reads camera streams from the panel. TCP is the most reliable; try UDP only if streams don't start.

snapshotStream.title: Camera snapshot stream
snapshotStream.description: Which camera stream the Home app's preview images (snapshots) are taken from. Standard definition is lighter and is what version 1.10 used; cameras without one use HD. Choose HD if snapshots fail or look wrong.

showCameraConfig.title: Show camera config
showCameraConfig.description: Prints a homebridge-camera-ffmpeg configuration for every camera in the log. It includes each camera's RTSP URL with the panel login and password, so treat that log output like a password and turn this off again after copying what you need.
